info.name: Siemens MindSphere Asset Management Aspect Types Timeseries API

description.content:
The MindSphere Asset Management API enables creating and managing assets, defining aspect types and asset types, configuring data models, and handling connectivity for IoT devices. Supports hierarchical asset structures for digital twin modeling of industrial equipment.
